summary: Run existing test, lint and build commands on SSH hosts with working-tree sync, per-host locking and structured results.
description: Wrap existing project commands as named rr tasks that can run on configured SSH hosts. Working-tree synchronization, host failover and per-host locking support remote checks, while structured results point agents to failures and logs. The shared task file contains no personal host details. Host configuration and credentials remain the user's responsibility, and every command continues to work locally; stacks verify still runs locally.
seoDescription: Shared rr tasks for running existing test, lint and build commands on SSH hosts, with working-tree sync, host locking and structured results.

projectExamples.title: Remote Rust checks
projectExamples.description: Run the desktop project's Rust and frontend checks on hosts with the required toolchains. Native bundle checks need the chosen operating system and dependencies.

projectExamples.title: Split remote test areas
projectExamples.description: Define remote tasks around the Python and React project's existing checks. Configure hosts separately and keep the same checks runnable locally.

plain.whatItIs: Named tasks that run existing project checks on configured remote computers.
goodAt: Running checks on hosts with the needed tools
Finding test results and logs from remote runs
notGoodAt: Setting up personal SSH hosts; configure those separately.
